column1: # The servers this engine's committed answers come from. default judges compat.tsv
# and records the tapes: PostgreSQL 17, the release the parser's grammar is read from
# (gram.y, src/backend/parser/gram.y at the source tag). pg18 serves the tests that
# ask the next major: the analyzer's (pg_proc_generated.go is generated from 18) and
# the review walk's second run. pg12 to pg16 serve pg/driver's sync, so that
# every major release Bytebase supports (12 and later) answers its catalog
